summary.text: William Galvin is the incumbent Democratic Secretary of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, first elected in 1994 and seeking another term.

paragraphs.text: First elected Secretary of the Commonwealth in 1994; re-elected in 1998, 2002, 2006, 2010, 2014, 2018 and 2022.
